decision-tree.root-question: What is the state of the root CLAUDE.md at HEAD: missing, present but failing a check (secret scan, line budget, path existence, command run), or present and green?

branch.question: Do the build, test and lint commands already exist in a machine-readable place (Makefile, package.json scripts, pyproject, CI workflow)?

branch.conclusion: Bootstrap with `/init`, then replace any pasted README or doc content with `@path` imports and keep the command list verbatim from the existing scripts.
Write the command set first: each command copy-pasteable and verified to exit 0 on a fresh clone; only then add conventions and prohibitions.

branch.question: Which check fails: secret scan, line budget, path existence or command run, or is the failing content per-package rules in a monorepo root?

branch.conclusion: Rotate the exposed secret, replace it with the env-var or vault-item name, and wire the scanner into pre-commit and CI before any other edit.
Cut the root to commands, conventions, prohibitions and pointers until `wc -l` fits the declared budget; move depth into on-demand files.
Fix or remove every dead path and non-running command in this PR and add the path-existence check to CI so the next rename cannot reintroduce drift.
Split per-package commands and rules into `<subdir>/CLAUDE.md` files; leave cross-cutting conventions and a package map in the root.
Move absolute home paths, local ports and personal habits to `CLAUDE.local.md` or `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`; gitignore the local file.
Root file exists, fits its budget, scans clean and every path and command resolves. No authoring work; revisit when a referenced file is renamed.

example.p: Root CLAUDE.md is 480 lines against a declared budget of 100 and contains `cd api && pytest` and `cd web && pnpm test`. root_file == 'failing', failing_check == 'per_package_rules' → conclusion r-claude-md-subdir-scoping; the line budget is met as a side effect once the per-package content moves out.
